description_en: Creates a standard C2PA Content Credentials signing task for a single JPEG, PNG, or MP4 file
description_zh: 为单个JPEG、PNG或MP4文件创建标准C2PA内容凭证签名任务
name: CreateC2paSignTask

parameters.help_en: The absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL of the JPEG or PNG file to be signed. The URL can be up to 4,096 characters in length
